$comment: L2D-06-KEY-INSERT: keyboard shortcut contracts — special-char inserts, page/column breaks, endnote, equation, hyperlink. All chords verified in editor.js C1 SHORTCUT PARITY block (lines 10965-11082) + guarded ctrl block (11231/11233). Ledger token for these rows is the chord itself (e.g. 'ctrl+shift+space'); keyed by feature id. effektClass supplied by override so 'unclassified' ledger rows become runnable (classify() gives the override precedence).

shortcut.nonbreakingspace.note: ledger row: shortcut.nonbreakingspace — Ctrl+Shift+Space emits insertSymbol U+00A0 at the caret (editor.js:10983)

shortcut.nonbreakinghyphen.note: ledger row: shortcut.nonbreakinghyphen — Ctrl+Shift+Minus emits insertSymbol U+2011 (editor.js:11003, ev.code Minus)

shortcut.horizontalellipsis.note: ledger row: shortcut.horizontalellipsis — plain Alt+; emits insertSymbol U+2026 (editor.js:11069, ev.code Semicolon)

shortcut.copyrightsign.note: ledger row: shortcut.copyrightsign — Ctrl+Alt+G emits insertSymbol U+00A9 (editor.js:11039)

shortcut.eurosign.note: ledger row: shortcut.eurosign — Ctrl+Alt+E emits insertSymbol U+20AC (editor.js:11038)

shortcut.registeredsign.note: ledger row: shortcut.registeredsign — Ctrl+Alt+R emits insertSymbol U+00AE (editor.js:11041)

shortcut.trademarksign.note: ledger row: shortcut.trademarksign — Ctrl+Alt+T emits insertSymbol U+2122 (editor.js:11040)

shortcut.insertpagebreak.note: ledger row: shortcut.insertpagebreak — Ctrl+Enter emits insertPageBreak which plants div.page-break + trailing p (editor.js:11231, 1177-1194)

shortcut.insertcolumnbreak.note: ledger row: shortcut.insertcolumnbreak — Ctrl+Shift+Enter emits insertColumnBreak planting div.column-break (editor.js:11012, 1212-1227)

shortcut.insertendnotenow.note: ledger row: shortcut.insertendnotenow — Ctrl+Alt+D emits insertEndnote: sup.endnote-citation + span.endnote 'Endnote text' (editor.js:11031, 1228-1244)

shortcut.insertequation.note: ledger row: shortcut.insertequation — Ctrl+Alt+= emits equationTemplate without a value, inserting the default 'x' vector object as img.inline-object.vector-object[data-kind=equation] (editor.js:11026, 1545, 2356-2365, 13069-13095)

shortcut.inserthyperlink.note: ledger row: shortcut.inserthyperlink — Ctrl+K emits link -> insertLink opens #link-dialog and focuses #link-url (editor.js:11233, 1436, 2924-2942)

shortcut.insertfootnotenow.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-07 (L2M-05): Ctrl+Alt+F is now bound in the dedicated alt block to emitCommand('insertFootnote') (editor.js ~11094), the same runCommand target as toolbar #btn-footnote/ctx Insert; the chord inserts sup.footnote-citation + span.footnote 'Footnote text' (editor.js ~1228). The file/navigation panel that previously owned the chord moved to Ctrl+Alt+O (shortcut.openfilepanel re-keyed in shortcut-real.json)
